securityAppLock_controllerReason.en: Verify your identity to turn on App lock
securityAppLock_controllerReason.zh: 验证身份以开启应用锁

securityAppLock_controllerReason2.en: Verify your identity to turn off App lock
securityAppLock_controllerReason2.zh: 验证身份以关闭应用锁

securityAppLock_controllerReason3.en: Verify your identity to open LOOP

securityAppLock_gateBiometric.en: Unlock with this device's biometrics; falls back to the device passcode if not recognized
securityAppLock_gateBiometric.zh: 用这台设备的生物识别解锁；识别不了时会退回设备密码

securityAppLock_gateDeviceCredential.en: Unlock with this device's screen lock passcode
securityAppLock_gateDeviceCredential.zh: 用这台设备的锁屏密码解锁

securityAppLock_gateFailed.zh: 没有通过验证，可以再试一次。

securityAppLock_gateLockedOut.en: The system has paused verification for now. Wait a moment and try again, or use the device passcode.
securityAppLock_gateLockedOut.zh: 系统暂时停用了验证，等一会儿再试，或改用设备密码。

securityAppLock_gateNoCredentialSet.en: This device has no screen lock passcode or biometrics yet. Add one in system Settings first
securityAppLock_gateNoCredentialSet.zh: 这台设备还没有设置锁屏密码或生物识别，先在系统设置里加上

securityAppLock_gateS.zh: 验证没有完成 · 系统提示：{systemMessage}

securityAppLock_gateSwitch2.en: Haven't read this device's screen lock capability yet
securityAppLock_gateSwitch2.zh: 还没有读到这台设备的锁屏能力

securityAppLock_gateUnavailable.en: This device has no screen lock verification available right now.
securityAppLock_gateUnavailable.zh: 这台设备现在没有可用的锁屏验证。

securityAppLock_gateUnsupportedPlatform.en: This device doesn't support screen lock verification
securityAppLock_gateUnsupportedPlatform.zh: 这台设备不支持锁屏验证

securityAppLock_promptLoopAppLockPromptB.en: Require Face ID / fingerprint when you return after 60 seconds in the background, keeping your wallet and chats safer
securityAppLock_promptLoopAppLockPromptB.zh: 切到后台 60 秒后回来需要 Face ID / 指纹，钱包和聊天更安全
